read.thesis: UPS Q1 CY26 beat internal plans with US margin at 4% and $350M one-off costs; capacity cut ahead of Amazon glidedown completion, but FY26 guide only reaffirmed (9.6% margin, $89.7B revenue) with fuel and demand risk unpriced.

utilisation.quote: Our hub productivity is the best has been in 20 years, just to put a point on it.

capex.quote: Capital expenditures are still expected to be about $3 billion

triggers.label: Ops positions cut ~25,000 YoY
triggers.quote: we reduced operational positions by nearly 25,000 compared to the first quarter of last year

triggers.label: US RPP up 6.5%
triggers.quote: revenue per piece up 6.5% compared to the same period last year

triggers.label: US ADV down 8%
triggers.quote: total U.S. average daily volume was down 8% versus the first quarter of last year

triggers.label: FY26 guide reaffirmed, not raised
triggers.quote: Today, we are reaffirming 2026 consolidated financial goals.

guidance.quote: we expect to generate consolidated revenue of approximately $89.7 billion
a consolidated operating margin of approximately 9.6%
we expect revenue to be up low single digits and operating margin to be between 7.5% and 8.5%
we expect low single-digit revenue growth and an operating margin between 13% and 14%
We expect free cash flow to be approximately $5.5 billion, including onetime payments
we are firmly on track to achieve our $3 billion cost-out target for the year

prior_guidance_check.quote: operating margin was 4%, including a 250 basis point negative impact from the short-term cost pressures

prior_guidance_check.metric: Amazon volume reduction target 50% by June 2026

red_flags.label: Q1 CPP up 9.5% YoY
red_flags.quote: Cost per piece in the first quarter increased 9.5% year-over-year.

red_flags.label: Consumer confidence at historic lows
red_flags.quote: U.S. consumer confidence, which is at historic lows

evasions.quote: it's not appropriate for us to update until we have further clarity on how long this will last.
at the end of the year, we'll give you a sense of what we think '27 will look like
